Twelve cards are rejected for the same systemic defect: the Hindi throughout the batch spells 'gratuity' as 'उपादान' (a real but unrelated Sanskrit/Nyaya term meaning 'material cause' / raw material, e.g. उपादान कारण), when the established, correct administrative term — used in scripts/authoring/hindi/ccs-pension.json's own headings for rules 45, 47, 48, 65 and 83, and the one the Payment of Gratuity Act's own Hindi title uses (उपदान संदाय अधिनियम) — is 'उपदान'. The two words differ by a single मात्रा and are easy to conflate, but they do not mean the same thing, and several of the affected cards put the wrong word directly in the front stem, the back, or the correct answer's own option text — so a reader would learn the wrong technical term for exactly the concept the card is teaching. Rejections stay in data/rules/cards/ with reviewState 'rejected' and are never served. (Update: the 12 cards originally rejected for the उपादान/उपदान gratuity-terminology error were corrected in scripts/authoring/authored/ccs-pension.json and re-approved rather than discarded.)
